assertions.description: OfflineAudioContext.prototype.close is a function (the explainer's feature-detection signal for incremental rendering).

assertions.test: (()=>{if(typeof OfflineAudioContext!=='function'||typeof OfflineAudioContext.prototype.close!=='function')return false;const c=new OfflineAudioContext({numberOfChannels:1,length:1000,sampleRate:8000});const p=c.close();const ok=p instanceof Promise;p.catch(()=>{});return ok;})()

assertions.description: startRendering(chunkSize) on a finite context resolves with at most chunkSize frames, not the full buffer.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof OfflineAudioContext!=='function')return false;const c=new OfflineAudioContext({numberOfChannels:1,length:4096,sampleRate:8000});const b=await c.startRendering(1024);return b.length<=1024;})()

assertions.description: startRendering can be called again after a chunk resolves, as long as the context has not closed.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof OfflineAudioContext!=='function')return false;const c=new OfflineAudioContext({numberOfChannels:1,length:4096,sampleRate:8000});const b1=await c.startRendering(1024);if(c.state==='closed')return false;try{const b2=await c.startRendering(1024);return b1.length<=1024&&b2.length<=1024;}catch(e){return false;}})()

assertions.description: A finite-length context delivers its frames across multiple chunked pulls and transitions to "closed" by itself after the final one.
After close(), a further startRendering call rejects and the context state reads "closed".
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof OfflineAudioContext!=='function'||typeof OfflineAudioContext.prototype.close!=='function')return false;const c=new OfflineAudioContext({numberOfChannels:1,length:16000,sampleRate:8000});await c.startRendering(512);await c.close();if(c.state!=='closed')return false;try{await c.startRendering(512);return false;}catch(e){return true;}})()

assertions.description: An indefinite-length context is constructible via at least one of length: null, length: Infinity, or an omitted length.
assertions.test: (()=>{if(typeof OfflineAudioContext!=='function')return false;const tries=[{numberOfChannels:1,length:null,sampleRate:8000},{numberOfChannels:1,length:Infinity,sampleRate:8000},{numberOfChannels:1,sampleRate:8000}];for(const o of tries){try{new OfflineAudioContext(o);return true;}catch(e){}}return false;})()

assertions.description: Backwards compatibility: startRendering() with no argument on a finite context still resolves with the full-length buffer.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof OfflineAudioContext!=='function')return false;const c=new OfflineAudioContext({numberOfChannels:1,length:2000,sampleRate:8000});const b=await c.startRendering();return b.length===2000;})()
